'''Ships of the Line''' is the 51st virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on August 11, 2023. The set consists of 18 cards. 

==Type Breakdown==
*3 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*5 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*2 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*8 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Bajoran, 1 Cardassian, 1 Dominion, 2 Federation, 1 Hirogen, 1 Klingon, and 1 Romulan)

==Rarity Breakdown==
*18 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
